programs.description: A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.
A man with fetal alcohol syndrome keeps himself alive by drinking a certain amount of alcohol. However, things change when he falls in love with a beautiful woman.
Following a tycoon's discovery of a rare oil reserve, a compassionate beggar gets trapped in the dangerous mechanisms of his rapacious scheme.
Ganesh, Diganth and Kitty arrive in Mugilupete to stay at Diganth's grandfather's farmhouse. However, there Ganesh falls in love with Sowmya, a widow who stays with her in-laws, Kodandaram and Padma.
Ganesh, also known as Eshwar, is compelled to move to the city after the bloodshed in his native town devastates him. When he returns years later, he adopts the task of educating people.
Prabhu, Chandru and Siddesh aspire to have a government job and try to lead a simple lifestyle. But their lives change dramatically when they attempt to unite two lovers.
Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.
When Ravi unknowingly thwarts Bittu's bank heist, he becomes the target of Bittu's wrath. Subsequently, Ravi is forced to fight to protect his loved ones from the ruthless criminal.

When he arrives in the city to earn a living, Yadhunandhan is helped by Mayakka, a gangster, who also gives him a place to live. When she is killed by a rival gang, Yadhunandhan decides to avenge her.
Lakshminarayana, a CBI officer, is drawn into a dangerous conspiracy when his wife Priya vanishes after discovering hidden weapons, leading him on a mission that uncovers shocking truths.
With limited evidence in a race against time, two police officers must combine their skills and experience to arrest a psychopath targeting women.
Param, a wealthy young man, becomes romantically attached to Deepa. He soon learns that his friend Sanvi loves him and attempts to mend their relationship.
Siddhe Gowda, an unemployed young man, decides to run against Bachche Gowda, the village head, in the local election. He also begins to fall in love with Nandini, the daughter of a marriage broker.
Manu, a kick-boxer must train and win an upcoming tournament to fulfill his mother's wishes and to become the best in the world.
After a villager secures a marriage alliance with a city boy for his only daughter, he prepares to offer a sacrifice to the gods. However, things go awry during the ceremony.

When he arrives in the city to earn a living, Yadhunandhan is helped by Mayakka, a gangster, who also gives him a place to live. When she is killed by a rival gang, Yadhunandhan decides to avenge her.
A special agent investigates a murder committed by a masked group of serial killers. However, a tangled maze of clues soon leads him to the drug kingpin of Chennai.

programs.showName: Marakkar: Lion of the Arabian Sea
programs.description: Kunjali Marakkar IV, a fearless naval commander, rises against Portuguese tyranny. With courage and cunning, he leads a legendary resistance, defending his people in a thunderous clash of empires.
A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.
A businessman returns to his homeland to reconcile with his friend. Soon, upon learning of his friend's plight, he becomes a crusader for the farmers in the village.
After falling in love with Suchitra, Appu must go against the odds to win her over and marry her despite her father's disapproval of him.

Shivalinga, a poor laborer, fails to earn enough money to save his mother's life. Later, he rescues a kidnapped girl and, aiming to fund her education, joins the underworld, leading to chaotic events.
When Bramhavar, a kind man, is wrongly charged with murder, a lawyer comes to his rescue and determinedly strives to clear Bramhavar's name.
A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.
An intelligent and ambitious youngster arrives in Mumbai and becomes a mafia don, but one day, things take turn when he falls in love with a cop's daughter.
A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
Surya and his sister Vidya are orphans who are often mistreated by local ruffians. Years later, Surya grows up and becomes an honest police officer and sets off to find the killers of his guardian.
Raghuchandra changes his identity in order to marry his cousin to settle the family conflict between his father and aunt.
When a taxi driver begins to experience various eerie events in his vehicle, he strives to uncover the truth behind the mysterious occurrences.
A bountiful and helpful boy falls in love with a musician without knowing the fact that a rich spoilt brat is also planning to woo her.
With limited evidence in a race against time, two police officers must combine their skills and experience to arrest a psychopath targeting women.
Satya slips into a coma after undergoing a face transplant after an accident where his face is damaged and his lover Deepthi dies. On waking up, he decides to avenge her death.
The grandson of a rich businessman promises to reunite him with his estranged daughter and enters their home in disguise. However, he has to deal with several challenges to keep his promise.

When he arrives in the city to earn a living, Yadhunandhan is helped by Mayakka, a gangster, who also gives him a place to live. When she is killed by a rival gang, Yadhunandhan decides to avenge her.
ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.
Shankar, a factory worker, is forced to marry his employer's daughter who is arrogant. He decides to teach her a lesson in order to make her realize her fault.
A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.
Krishna, an orphan medical student, lives a seemingly ordinary life. However, unbeknownst to people, he is a vigilante named Jaguar who pursues a certain group of people in order to kill them.
A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.
